online-html-editor.formula:
No math - this is a code tool. The editor works like this:

1. You type HTML (with optional <style> and <script>).
2. The page sets it as the iframe preview's source document.
3. The browser renders it instantly, re-rendering on every keystroke.

Download: the same text becomes a .html file via a Blob download.
howTo: Type or paste HTML into the code area. A sample page is loaded to start.
Watch the preview update live as you type.
Add <style> for CSS and <script> for JavaScript inside your HTML.
Click Copy to copy the code, or Download HTML to save it as a file.
keyFacts: A live HTML editor shows a real browser render of your code as you type.
HTML is the structure of a page: headings, paragraphs, links, images, forms.
CSS goes in <style> tags and controls colors, layout, and fonts.
JavaScript goes in <script> tags and makes pages interactive.
The preview here is sandboxed: scripts run, but they cannot read your storage or this page.
Downloading gives you a real .html file you can open anywhere or host on any static host.
Character and line counts below the preview help with size limits, like email templates.
online-html-editor.keywords: html editor, live html editor, online html editor, html preview, test html online, html playground
limitations: The preview cannot load local files by path or read localStorage - the sandbox blocks same-origin features.
No backend, so forms cannot really submit anywhere and server languages like PHP do not run.
Very large pages may make the live preview slower on old devices.
Your code is not saved automatically. Download or copy before closing the tab.
